subject.title: Feature request: Auto-send intent/acknowledgment text message before agent processing

question: Should OpenClaw solve pre-processing acknowledgement text as shared messages.ackText config, a non-terminal send-and-continue hook, or channel-specific placeholder features?
rationale: The missing behavior is real, but each viable path adds config or plugin/channel API surface and changes visible message delivery semantics across supported channels.

options.title: Approve Shared Ack Text Config
options.body: Add a default-off shared acknowledgement text contract with scope and per-channel or per-account overrides, plus schema, docs, channel delivery tests, and live proof.

options.title: Add A Non-Terminal Hook First
options.body: Expose a typed plugin/channel hook that can send interim text and then continue normal dispatch, leaving acknowledgement policy to plugins or channel owners.

options.title: Keep Placeholders Channel-Specific
options.body: Let the narrower Telegram, Slack, Discord, and Feishu placeholder requests own each channel's UX while this broad issue remains product direction.

recommendation.title: Approve Shared Ack Text Config
recommendation.body: Add a default-off shared acknowledgement text contract with scope and per-channel or per-account overrides, plus schema, docs, channel delivery tests, and live proof.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest combined history on cross-channel reply delivery, acknowledgement cleanup, and prior review of this issue.
